script.topic: Boiler Pressure Dropping in Sub-Zero Weather
script.hook: Right lads, Trevor here. If your boiler pressure dropping in sub-zero weather is playing up today, stop and listen before you call a rogue tradesman.
script.body: First thing: check the pressure gauge right under the unit. If it's below one bar, you don't need a new pump—you just need to open the filling loop until it hits 1.5. Nine times out of ten that resets the lockout completely.
